'''Ledo Melnic''' was a male [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he resided in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] and served as a [[Magistrate/Legends|magistrate]]. He asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] passerby to help him deal with a group of rogue [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] lead by war-master [[Rhigoth]], who have threatened to go to war with the local security forces.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
